newsitem.title: BELGIUM: EU Commission calls for closer EU-Turkey links.
newsitem.headline: EU Commission calls for closer EU-Turkey links.

text.p: The European Commission called on Tuesday for the European Union to develop closer links with Turkey, extending beyond the current EU-Turkish customs union.
In a brief statement, it stopped short of suggesting a start of membership talks with Ankara but said it had identified areas for new cooperation following a request by EU foreign ministers in April.

The call came as the Commission formally agreed to recommend that EU membership talks begin next year with Poland, Hungary, the Czech Republic, Estonia and Slovenia. The EU has previously agreed to begin talks with Cyprus.

EU relations with Turkey were strained earlier this year when Christian Democrat leaders, including German Chancellor Helmut Kohl, appeared to rule out Turkish EU membership for ever on cultural grounds.

The bloc's foreign ministers sought to undo the damage in April by stating that Turkey was eligible for EU membership one day and ordering the Commission to look into ways of strengthening economic ties.
